name: Natural Sciences PhD
detailsNote: Archive Cell Biology and Biophysics maps biology disciplines of current Natural Sciences PhD, reviewed jointly; other non-biology disciplines not detailed here. Dates undated, Fall2027 not confirmed. Uniform admission model not established.

publishedDeadlines.note: Undated Natural Sciences schedule; late review space-available.

timeline.decisions: By February15 for applications received by December15, undated schedule.

documents: Official transcripts from all prior institutions
requirements.note: Natural Sciences GPA2.75 undergraduate or3.0 post-bachelor coursework; admissions page lists both benchmarks separately, confirm evaluation. Qualifying bachelor/equivalent. GRE suggested, not required except Biomedical/Health Informatics; catalog later contains generic conflicting international-GRE language, confirm with coordinator. Choose primary discipline, optional secondary; CBB/MBB reviewed as group. Coordinator contact strongly recommended. Catalog requires official records before review.

english.note: Higher Graduate Biology Programs row still uses former IPhD label; IELTS each6.5. Confirm applicability to renamed degree. General exemptions: listed-country citizenship, US compositionI/II C+, degree/24 non-ESL credits US/Canada/UK/NZ/Australia, or US high school. Country-degree exemption for CS/chemistry/engineering does not name biology. Coordinator-supported written English waiver possible, not automatic.

applicationFee.note: International75USD; domestic45. No applicable fee-waiver route established on reviewed sources.

funding.note: CBB page describes tuition remission and undated26000USD stipend,27000after qualifying exam; payment period/year and multi-year duration unstated. This is CBB-scoped; no identical MBB funding guarantee inferred.
